description: Java source file defining a REST API resource for bulk import operations in the Fineract project, including endpoints for retrieving import documents, output template locations, and downloading templates.

classes.name: BulkImportApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for handling bulk import related endpoints, including retrieving import data, output template locations, and downloading templates.

methods.name: retrieveImportDocuments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve import documents based on entity type, with permission validation and serialization of results.

methods.name: retriveOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the location of the output template for a given import document ID.

methods.name: getOutputTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to download the output template as an Excel file for a given import document ID.
